audit.assets: Existing library policy reviewed; this stage introduces no new visual pack or duplicate assets. Existing system map continues in docs/DEVELOPMENT_STATUS.json. No complete FPS/CI/release certification was performed.

implemented: Stable-ID residents store compact JSON-safe local transforms, parent anchor, role, doorway transit, route index and bounded activity/reaction timers. No Node references or transient doorway owner IDs are saved.

GameState snapshots capture live residents at the actual save boundary; unloading captures the last grounded state. A load updates already loaded residents, restores physical doors before their transit and revalidates ground before showing the model.

State revisions prevent old-scene teardown from repopulating a new game. Legacy phase-only data uses the authored spawn; malformed/nonfinite/out-of-range coordinates and wrong anchors are rejected, optional timers are bounded.
The actual working-square regression now destroys/recreates its nodes during doorway transit and requires both residents to finish going home and return to their real workplaces.

native_method: Official graphical game against the frozen exported PCK, external input driver from the prior earned slot 2. Ordinary move_forward, unchanged walk speed 5, no driver coordinate assignment. Walk east to +600 m and back, enter the home through the actual ray/reach interaction, save/load normal slot 3. Only the inspection fixture holds clock/survival at 22:00. This is automated native inspection, not a manual full-world playthrough or FPS benchmark.
known_issues: No continuous simulation of distant residents; on return they resume the latest schedule from retained positions. Pending short reactions retain active-state time.
Only explicitly stable-ID residents get transform persistence; anonymous/background actors, animals and other planned systems are not certified by this stage.
Most city houses remain closed; sleeping, household/storage interactions, full social relationships and external LLM behavior remain unfinished.
Human materials/grip, sparse forests, repeated architecture and large empty city spaces remain below requested realism.
Existing ObjectDB/UID warnings remain; full performance/memory, Windows updater and remote stable release gates not certified.
next_stage: Add a usable household interaction with saved consequences in the existing region.
Add bounded distant schedule progression using a reliable game-time basis, then extend the verified residence template.
Finish starting-region tools/quest/guild/wildlife loops in the order defined by the master specification; do not add mass new regions.
